title: Parishad Domain Glossary
description: Verified terminology and concepts specific to Parishad (Parishad) architecture and review workflows.

terms.definition: An incoming, unverified text submission (from a GitHub Pull Request, Slack thread, Jira ticket, or document sync) requesting a modification to hardware specifications, system configurations, software parameters, or business policies.
terms.parishad_context: The raw input submitted to the Parishad pipeline before security filtering, fact extraction, and document verification.

terms.definition: A quantitative measurement, parameter limit, or financial budget extracted from free text by the fact extraction engine, containing numeric value, canonical unit, display unit, and change type.
terms.parishad_context: Structured numerical entities such as 60.0 V, 14 days, $8500 USD, or 2.0 Mbps parsed deterministically from change text.

terms.definition: A certified company specification, operational limit guide, policy document, or architectural decision record (ADR) stored as source-of-truth in the database.
terms.parishad_context: Contains unique doc_id (e.g., DOC-BMS-402), topic, title, version, and certified markdown content.

terms.definition: A specific numerical constraint or operational threshold linked to an official document against which proposed updates are validated.
terms.parishad_context: Stores parameter label, certified numeric limit (float), and canonical unit (e.g., Max Voltage Limit = 54.0 V).

terms.definition: A condition where a proposed update introduces a numeric magnitude differing from the certified official rule, or introduces incompatible or altered measurement dimensions.
terms.parishad_context: Triggers mathematical drift calculation (delta_pct) and severity classification (low, medium, high, critical).

terms.definition: Stage 1 analysis in the Council of Agents pipeline that evaluates numerical alignment between proposed facts and the top-matched official specification.
terms.parishad_context: Calculates percentage delta, assigns initial severity level, and formulates technical justification.

terms.definition: Stage 2 analysis in the Council of Agents pipeline that checks for multi-document ripple effects, subsystem dependencies, and historical precedents.
terms.parishad_context: Identifies cascading impacts on connected specifications (e.g., thermal impact of overvoltage) and audits prior rulings in the decision ledger.

terms.definition: Stage 3 consensus stage in the Council of Agents pipeline that consolidates First Opinion and Cross-Review into a single actionable review verdict.
terms.parishad_context: Produces executive summary, recommended action (AUTO_PASS vs STAGE_APPROVAL), and draft replacement text.

terms.definition: Multi-signal search system combining lexical BM25 token scoring, TF-IDF term overlap, and 768-dimensional dense vector embeddings with domain-specific topic and unit boosting.
terms.parishad_context: Retrieves the most relevant official company documents to serve as grounded evidence for every finding.

terms.definition: A downstream architectural, electrical, mechanical, or operational consequence triggered in another system or document when a parameter is altered.
terms.parishad_context: Example: Raising battery voltage from 54V to 60V risks MOSFET thermal breakdown under high ambient temperature.

terms.definition: A discrete, traceable observation produced by Parishad identifying a policy conflict, parameter drift, safety risk, or verification gap, indexed by a permanent finding ID.
terms.parishad_context: Must be preserved with its original identifier (e.g., FIND-01) and evidence citation across all summaries.

terms.definition: An actionable suggestion proposing a fix, additional testing, or documentation update, explicitly categorized as required fix, optional suggestion, or verification needed.
terms.parishad_context: Actionable guidance helping the engineer or approver resolve findings safely without fabricating requirements.

terms.definition: The mandatory human-in-the-loop review gate where an authorized human engineer inspects staged revisions and explicitly accepts or declines them.
terms.parishad_context: Under the strict 'Drafts Only' architecture, AI models cannot mutate official specifications without human sign-off.

terms.definition: An append-only, tamper-evident audit ledger that records every approved or declined change with an immutable SHA-256 cryptographic hash and increments doc version (e.g. v2.4 to v2.5).
terms.parishad_context: Ensures full traceability of who changed what parameter, when, why, and under which evidence.

terms.definition: A condition where an incoming proposal lacks essential details (e.g. test data, target environment, ambient limits) needed to verify compliance.
terms.parishad_context: The specialist must explicitly highlight missing evidence rather than assuming or hallucinating parameters.

terms.definition: The critical architectural distinction between technical pipeline failures (e.g. database timeout, malformed JSON, model crash) and domain policy disagreements (proposed 60V vs certified 54V limit).
terms.parishad_context: System errors must trigger deterministic fallbacks and alerts; policy conflicts must be flagged as review findings.
